invariants.rationale: idPfx is expected to identify a partition or a write target and should not be null for meaningful execution.
recordItr is used immediately and should not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
recordItr.hasNext() is called at method start, so it is well-defined.
All Java strings have a non-negative length; safe since idPfx must be non-null to execute as in the body.
recordItr is expected to be a valid Iterator reference.
